_meta.slice: S2 — stances on the storyline proposals. ADDITIVE to S1. stance ∈ support|oppose|mixed. Officials' stances map to votes.metadata.statement (officials aren't users — the S1 mapping lesson); citizen stances map to entity_positions. Passive officials (Crane/Sterns) post none.
_meta.scope: CM-22 broadband, HB-09 water, CM-15 STR get stances; the breadth bills + the light stadium are left to organic comments / volume.

positions.author: off-bell
positions.statement: A city that works needs a network that works — and a state match means we build it once, for everyone, not twice.

positions.author: off-okonkwo
positions.statement: Tie the match to a published coverage map. Fiber we can't audit is a promise, not a plan.

positions.author: off-massey
positions.statement: Riverside already pays the highest rates in the city. I won't bond us deeper to wire blocks the carriers should be wiring themselves.

positions.author: off-hutchins
positions.statement: I'm the swing here and I'll say it plainly: build-out-to-the-county-line language earns my yes. Without it, I'm a no.

positions.author: off-hale
positions.statement: Senior agricultural rights honored, verified metering for all, and a drought floor the river never drops below. That's the deal.

positions.author: off-reyes-combs
positions.statement: Minimum in-stream flow isn't anti-farm — it's the insurance the whole valley draws on in a dry year.

positions.author: off-finch
positions.statement: Downtown is becoming a hotel with no front desk. A cap plus a primary-residence carve-out keeps neighborhoods as neighborhoods.

positions.author: off-coley
positions.statement: Ward 4 families rent rooms to make the mortgage. Don't fix a downtown problem by taxing the people barely holding on.

positions.author: cit-transittina
positions.statement: Yes. Three providers, none working past 6pm. Build it.

positions.author: cit-remoterraywfh
positions.statement: Support — but only if the match reaches the county lines. The city doesn't need it; the mountain does.

positions.author: cit-farmbureaufran
positions.statement: Came in opposed. If senior rights are honored and the floor is real, I can live with metering.

positions.author: cit-dell-r
positions.statement: A Watauga meter on my family's ninety-year withdrawal? Show me the senior-rights language first.

positions.author: cit-milltownmarie
positions.statement: Half my block is lockboxes. Cap the investor units.

positions.author: cit-fifthstreetcafe
positions.statement: Primary-residence carve-out, cap the pure investor units. The middle is right there.
